answer.line: Rise -2 over run -7: two negatives divide to a positive, 2/7, about 0.29.

steps: Set an order and keep it: second point minus first, on the top and on the bottom.
Rise: -14 - (-12) = -2. Run: -16 - (-9) = -7. Minus a negative is plus.
Slope is rise over run: -2 / -7 = 2/7, about 0.29.
Check the picture. Going left 7 drops 2, which is the same as going right 7 and rising 2. Positive slope.

choices.note: -2 + (-7) = -9 adds the rise and the run. Slope is a ratio: rise divided by run.
Taking y in one order and x in the other flips the sign. Keep the same order on top and bottom.
0.08 writes the run as -16 - 9 = -25, losing the minus on -9. Minus a negative adds: -16 + 9 = -7.
Down 2 for every 7 to the left: up to the right.
-7 / -2 = 3.5 puts the run over the rise. Slope is rise over run.

lockIt: Slope is rise over run, both taken in the same order. Two negatives divide to a positive.
